title: Jamaican Beef Stew
description: A hearty Jamaican-inspired beef stew made with tender beef, unique spices, and a hint of bitterness from the stew. Serve with some crusty bread for a comforting meal.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add beef and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add jerk seasoning and cook for 1 minute.
Add stew, unique spice blend, salt, bell pepper, carrots, and potatoes.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours, or until meat is tender.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
